skill.name: socialdatax-short-video-copy-extract
skill.description: 面向短视频文案提取、短视频文案一键提取、视频文案提取、视频链接转文案、短视频转文字、视频转文字、口播转文字、视频逐字稿和逐字稿整理。当前 direct CLI 入口支持小红书、抖音、快手、微博和视频号公开视频链接、分享文案、内容 ID 或已有 job_id，获取视频基础信息、原视频简介、口播逐字稿、可复制文案和精简版；其他平台不在本 Skill 范围内，来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Extract transcripts, reusable copy, and optional SRT subtitles from public videos on five supported platforms through SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown, readable Chinese prose, or scoped credential configuration rather than malicious behavior. The command block executes an unpinned npm package, creating supply-chain exposure; the polling instructions also lack a deadline. No evidence found of credential exfiltration or prompt injection in the supplied files; external package and service implementations were not reviewed.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest without a fixed, reviewed package version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify package provenance before execution. Limit installation permissions and avoid exposing unrelated secrets to the process.

remediation.issue: Nonterminal jobs trigger continued polling without a request limit or elapsed-time deadline.
remediation.suggestion: Add a polling deadline, a maximum request count, and bounded backoff. Return the existing job ID when those limits are reached.

content.user_title: Extract Short Video Transcripts with SocialDataX
content.value_statement: Public short videos often contain spoken information that is difficult to reuse as text. This skill guides SocialDataX transcription and organizes returned results into transcripts, reusable copy, and concise summaries.
actual_capabilities: Route public videos from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels to their documented transcription commands.
Accept video links, share text, platform content IDs, or existing job IDs through platform-specific inputs.
Submit transcription tasks and query existing jobs through the direct CLI or an already connected hosted MCP service.
Organize returned metadata, original descriptions, transcripts, reusable copy, and concise summaries without inventing missing information.
Export SRT subtitles through CLI version 0.2.64 or newer when valid timing segments and a writable new file path are available.
Handle terminal failures, retryability indicators, credential availability checks, and insufficient-balance errors.
limitations: The documented direct CLI supports only Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels public videos.
Processing depends on the external SocialDataX service, valid authentication, available balance, and retrievable video resources.
Direct CLI execution requires Node.js, npm, and network access; the external package and hosted service are not bundled or independently verified.
Hosted MCP does not save local SRT files; CLI export requires valid timing segments and cannot overwrite an existing file.

use_cases.title: Prepare Copy from Recorded Speech
use_cases.description: Extract a public video transcript and organize its existing ideas into reusable copy and a concise summary.

use_cases.title: Review Public Video Statements
use_cases.description: Collect returned video context and ordered speech transcripts while clearly marking metadata that the service did not return.

use_cases.title: Export Timed Subtitles
use_cases.description: Use a successful transcription job to save an SRT file when the service provides valid timing segments.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Video Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the transcript from this public Douyin video: [video link]. Include the returned description and a concise summary.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Share Text into Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Xiaohongshu share text: [share text]. Return available metadata, the original description, the transcript, reusable copy, and a concise summary.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Existing Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume Kuaishou transcription job [job ID] without submitting the video again. Return the completed transcript or the terminal error and retry guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Export Subtitles from an Existing Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the direct CLI to query WeChat Channels job [job ID] and export SRT to [new path]. Verify timing segments and never overwrite files.

best_practices: Provide one supported platform input per call and retain the job ID to avoid duplicate submissions.
Configure credentials through trusted secret settings in the actual execution environment; never paste real keys into chat or logs.
Use a reviewed CLI version and agree on a polling deadline. Confirm timing data and a new writable path before requesting SRT export.
anti_patterns: Repeatedly submit the same video after receiving a job ID instead of querying that existing task.
Treat incomplete jobs as finished transcripts or invent missing metadata, speech, or subtitle timestamps.
Use unsupported platform commands or request account actions such as posting, liking, commenting, or login.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The documented direct CLI supports Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels public videos.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a video link, share text, a platform-specific content ID, or an existing job ID. Use only one input type per call.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Direct CLI use requires a SocialDataX key in its execution environment. An already authenticated hosted MCP connection does not require local CLI credentials.

faq.question: Can it export SRT subtitles?
faq.answer: Yes, through CLI version 0.2.64 or newer with valid timing segments and a new writable file path. Hosted MCP cannot save local files.

faq.question: What happens when transcription is still processing?
faq.answer: Query the same job ID on the same platform. The instructions continue polling until completion, tool interruption, or user cancellation, without a built-in deadline.

faq.question: What should I do when balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop repeated requests and review the official SocialDataX billing page. After resolving balance, resume the existing task when a job ID is available.
